name: Paper Masks
source:
To escape your past, you take on a fake identity and land a job with the wealthy, enigmatic Woods family. It is supposed to be a simple plan: stay quiet, stay useful, stay hidden. But nothing stays simple when Max Woods enters the picture.

Clever, volatile, and far too observant for your liking, Max becomes both your greatest threat and your most unexpected ally. As you navigate the secrets of the Woods household, you are pulled into a tense, intimate dance with someone who could expose everything or save you from it.

Keep your cover intact, uncover the truth behind Max's guarded past, and survive a summer full of deception, power plays, and dangerous attraction. But remember, masks slip, and when they do, someone always gets burned. 

[From [url=https://larkylabs.itch.io/paper-masks]itch.io[/url]]
